error_framing.false_positive_cost: Unnecessary rotation or markdown of stock that would have sold. Costs staff time and margin.
error_framing.false_negative_cost: Expired stock that was never flagged: full unit cost plus disposal. The expensive error for a pharmacy.
error_framing.asymmetry_note: Recall is prioritised for the critical band because a missed expiry costs more than an unnecessary rotation.

label_definition: at_risk = realised_unsold_units > 0 under FEFO allocation of actual sales observed between the assessment date and the batch expiry date
